units.source_text: 这首诗告诉我们：在禽兽草木之中，可以寻到你，寻到我，

en.t: This poem tells us that among birds and beasts, grasses and trees, we can find you and find me,

units.source_text: 并且还可以渐渐地拾回我那颗宽宏大量的热爱天地万物的心。

en.t: and that we can also gradually recover that broad and generous heart of mine, the heart that passionately loves heaven, earth, and all things.
